title: Python Retriever
briefMd:
# Python Retriever

Write a Python retriever. Your program reads `/workspace/input.json` (same directory as `main.py`) and prints JSON:

```json
{ "results": [ { "id": "h01", "passages": ["..."] } ] }
```

`input.json` contains the public corpus and the questions to answer. Hidden gold answers are **not** in the sandbox.

For each question return up to 5 passages. Pass when recall@5 is at least 0.80 on the hidden set.

A keyword-overlap ranker over whole documents is enough. Returning the same short snippet for every question will fail.
